_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitākaro {player_id} i te kēmu o LinesOfAction.
Ko āu pīki ' {side} ', ko ngā pīki o te hoa whawhai ' {other} '.
Tauwhiti nekehanga: `[b1b3]` (tauwhiti-tīmata ki te tauwhiti-whāiti). He nekehanga ture e haere ana ki te tīeke, ki te poutū, ki te diagonal rānei, e rite ana ki te maha o ngā pīki (he tae noa) i taua rārangi. Ka taea te peke atu i āu ake pīki, engari kaua i ngā pīki o te hoa whawhai; ka mau i te whāiti o te hoa whawhai.  Ka toa koe ina hono ngā pīki katoa ki a koe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ko te hōputu me e2e4 (mai,ki ngā taunga).
invalid_move.no_piece: Kāore he {side} wāhanga i runga i te {coord}.
invalid_move.identical: He ōrite te pūtake me te ūnga.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Me tika, kia tapatapahi rānei te nekehanga.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Me neke te tawhiti e ōrite ana ki ngā wāhanga i runga rārangi.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Ka aukati te hoa riri i te huarahi.
invalid_move.destination_own: Ko te ūnga e nohoia ana e tōna ake tūāwhiorangi.

game_action.captured_suffix: Kaitakaro {player_id} neke {from} -> {to}, ka hopu i te hoariri.

outcome.win: Ko ngā wāhanga katoa e hono ana.
outcome.draw_repetition: Ka tuaruatia te tūnga kia toru ngā wā.
